definitions.explanation: Indicates the absence or non-existence of something. The negative counterpart of ある.
Indicates that someone doesn't possess something.

examples.english: I don't have time. / There is no time.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ない⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{買|か}えません→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I can't buy it because I don't have money.

examples.japanese: ⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ない⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Are there no problems? / Is there no issue?

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ない⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ゆっくり→ゆっくり：00910_yukkuri⟧⟦{休|やす}みます→休む：00606_yasumu⟧。
examples.english: I don't have work today, so I'll relax at home.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なに}も→何も：03874_nanimo⟧ない。
⟦{心配|しんぱい}→心配：00811_shinpai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ない。
⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ない⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{不安|ふあん}→不安：00836_fuan⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: I'm anxious because I don't have experience.

examples.japanese: ⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧なかった。

notes: ない conjugates as an i-adjective: なくない (negative - 'is it not nonexistent?'), なくて (te-form), なかった (past). ない is the negative form of ある (to exist/have for inanimate things). For animate things (people/animals), the negative of いる is いない. The kanji {無|な}い is sometimes used but hiragana is more common.
